Messages.Author: wijsman
Messages.Body:
Hello there,
I have a couple of questions. First, how do you play brujah debate when
you control two vamps, one 6 cap. and one 5 cap. The 6 cap. is already
tapped and has sensory deprivation on it when I play the brujah debate.
Can I still choose the 6 cap. vamp for the debate? Does any of this
change when the highest cap. vamp is in torpor?

Can Kostantin steal the shackles of enkidu of a 'shackled' vampire?

Finally, if one of my vamps blocks another vamp and engages in combat,
my vamp uses disguised weapon to play a white phospherous grenade and
after that I play a rotschreck. Is the grenade burned?

Thanks a lot, jw.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
In article <37DF4A...@planet.nl>,

wijs...@planet.nl wrote:
> Hello there,
> I have a couple of questions. First, how do you play brujah debate
when
> you control two vamps, one 6 cap. and one 5 cap. The 6 cap. is already
> tapped and has sensory deprivation on it when I play the brujah
debate.
> Can I still choose the 6 cap. vamp for the debate? Does any of this
> change when the highest cap. vamp is in torpor?

You must choose the 6 cap. It doesn't matter if he's already tapped
and/or in torpor.

> Can Kostantin steal the shackles of enkidu of a 'shackled' vampire?

Yes. And then he will be the "shackled" vampire. [LSJ 02-JUN-1999]

> Finally, if one of my vamps blocks another vamp and engages in combat,
> my vamp uses disguised weapon to play a white phospherous grenade and
> after that I play a rotschreck. Is the grenade burned?

No. The grenade is not burned until strike resolution, which doesn't
occur after Rotschreck is played in your example.

Messages.Author: Derek S. Ray
Messages.Body:
On Wed, 15 Sep 1999 09:25:58 +0200, wijsman <wijs...@planet.nl>
wrote:

>Hello there,
>I have a couple of questions. First, how do you play brujah debate when
>you control two vamps, one 6 cap. and one 5 cap. The 6 cap. is already
>tapped and has sensory deprivation on it when I play the brujah debate.
>Can I still choose the 6 cap. vamp for the debate? Does any of this
>change when the highest cap. vamp is in torpor?

Card text, Brujah Debate

"Master. Put this card in play. Each Methuselah with a ready Brujah
must tap the highest capacity Brujah he or she controls during his or
her master phase. Each Brujah gets +1 hand damage and an optional
maneuver each combat. This card may be burned by any minion who is not
Ventrue as a (D) action."

The highest capacity Brujah you control is the poor Sense-Depped
bastard. So, during your master phase, you tap him. Tapping a tapped
vampire means he stays tapped. Card text doesn't specify to tap an
"untapped" Brujah, or a "ready" Brujah, so no matter where that 6-cap
goes, you do not get the option - you MUST choose him to tap as long
as he's yours.

-- Derek
